prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a torn paper map; paper clips.
Opens on the coin stack, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as the coin stack flattens into a torn paper map; clips pin its separated pieces.
Ends holding on the torn map.
This composition is a diagram: several elements are arranged together.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "INTEGRATION RISK".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "INTEGRATION RISK". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage with a 2D motion design style, photographed as a flat lay under soft room light coming from the upper left. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a light blue paper ground, a cream-colored torn paper chip with the black text "$1.5B", and a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a stack of blank coins with rough white torn-paper edges. Immediately upon the first frame, the light blue ground is covered by a single, unbroken block of deep magenta paper. Simultaneously, the "$1.5B" headline chip slides rapidly off-frame to the left with a slight overshoot. The stack of coins flattens and expands outward, transforming into a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a torn paper map. The map is unmarked, featuring no lettering or symbols, and possesses the same rough white torn edges as the coins. As the map settles into a diagrammatic arrangement, several small, metallic-grey paper clips slide in quickly from the edges of the frame to pin down the separated pieces of the map. In the upper third of the frame, a new cream-colored paper chip lands sharply on the deep magenta ground, featuring the extra-bold black sans-serif text "INTEGRATION RISK" in clean, legible, and stable typography. Every element, including the map and the headline chip, casts a small, soft shadow toward the bottom right. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout. The video concludes with a hold on this final composition, with the elements performing a very subtle, rhythmic loop of micro-movements.

overall_soundscape: A series of crisp, rhythmic paper-slap sounds occur as the background changes and the headline chip lands. Distinct, sharp metallic clicks and subtle adhesive tape peeling sounds synchronize with the appearance of the paper clips pinning the map.
